transformation: Literal data array parsed without execution; sorted lexicographically, one unchanged entry per LF-terminated line. No words added or removed.
sourceClaim: Upstream describes list as The New Dale-Chall (1995); no independent reconstruction of printed edition.
hashConvention: Canonical LF file bytes; CRLF checkout translation normalized for verification.

smogReference.paper: G. Harry McLaughlin, SMOG Grading, Journal of Reading, May1969, pages639–646
smogReference.formula: Table1, equation(d), page643: g =3.1291+1.0430*sqrt(p), p=polysyllabic occurrences in30 sampled sentences.
smogReference.sampling: Three disjoint blocks of10 complete sentences at beginning, center and end; automatic English segmentation/syllables remain heuristic.
